title: What If You Quit Caffeine Today? The Clock Starts in 12 Hours

scenes.text: What if you quit caffeine today? Nothing happens at first. Then your body files a complaint.
Withdrawal typically begins 12 to 24 hours after your last dose.
It peaks between 20 and 51 hours in, and can last anywhere from two to nine days.
About half of people in studies get a headache. About 13 percent get distress bad enough to disrupt work.
Even stopping a dose as small as 100 milligrams a day, about one small cup of coffee, produced symptoms.
A review of 57 experimental studies found five symptom clusters, from fatigue and low mood to flu-like aches.

description:
What if you quit caffeine today?
